faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Airport Transfers
faq.q1: What happens if my flight is delayed?
faq.a1: We monitor your flight in real time using your flight number. Your chauffeur adjusts your pickup time automatically without extra charges.
faq.q2: Where do I meet my chauffeur at the airport?
faq.a2: Your chauffeur will greet you inside the arrivals terminal holding a personalized name sign and will assist you with all luggage.
faq.q3: Are child seats and ski equipment included?
faq.a3: Yes! Child seats and booster seats are complimentary on request. Our Mercedes Vans easily accommodate up to 8 passengers plus full winter ski gear.
faq.q4: Are the prices fixed without hidden charges?
faq.a4: Yes, our prices are guaranteed fixed rates including highway tolls, parking fees, and taxes with no hidden surcharges.
